measurement: per-process Linux Tegra NVMap IOVMM client SIZE, sampled every 0.1 s as root; calibrated against a live 512 MiB CUDA allocation and free
interpretation: Net process-owned NVMap bytes grew by the same 83,427,328 bytes from the stable sample immediately before the first graph-instantiation event through the sample immediately after the tenth successful event in all three service startups. This prices the graph-capture/instantiation startup interval for this IQ1_M configuration; it includes any other synchronous device-owner allocations in that interval and is not a graph-disabled differential or a universal per-graph executable size.
